title: What's New: Enhancements in Intrastat (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Feature 2: Multiple VAT numbers for customers
Demo setup and VAT number options

features.name: Mandatory fields for Intrastat documents
features.description: New functionality to set mandatory fields for sales, service, and purchase Intrastat documents before posting. This prevents users from submitting incomplete information when creating Intrastat reports.
caveats: Applies to transaction type and transfer method examples shown

features.name: Multiple VAT numbers support for Intrastat
features.description: New support for multiple VAT registration numbers for customers when reporting to Intrastat. Allows picking VAT number directly from the posted document based on ship-to address, complementing existing sell-to and bill-to options.
caveats: Requires proper VAT number configuration per address
Integration with new multiple VAT functionality for customers

features.name: Document option for VAT number selection
features.description: New document-level option to pick VAT registration number directly from the posted document for Intrastat reporting, replacing previous sell-to or bill-to customer options.
caveats: Works with ship-to address VAT numbers

features.name: Document check fact box for Intrastat validation
features.description: Visual fact box that displays missing mandatory field values before posting, allowing users to identify and correct errors immediately on the sales order.
caveats: Shows all missing mandatory fields configured in setup

features.name: Technical improvements to Intrastat (future)
features.description: Additional technical improvements to Intrastat functionality that will be delivered but are not visible on the user interface. Further details to be published in documentation.
features.status_evidence_quote: some other technical improvements will come related to interstat uh probably 26.12
caveats: Details to be published in documentation
